record.interface_detail: the `amp` CLI. Headless: `amp -x "prompt"` (execute mode) sends the prompt, waits for the agent's turn to end, prints the final message and exits, and turns on by itself when stdout is redirected; `amp -ox` is shorthand for `--orb-execute -x` and starts the same prompt in an Amp-hosted orb, prints the thread URL and exits; `--stream-json` streams the events, locally or from an orb; `--executor runner:<id>` targets one of the user's own runners; scripts and CI set AMP_API_KEY to an access token from Settings that starts with `sgamp_`

record.chaining: hosted lanes first: an Amp-hosted orb on Hobby is pay-as-you-go from USD 0.08 an hour (a1.tiny), Amp-served models are bought as credits with no markup on provider API prices, and the paid Individual tier (coding-subs/amp-individual) bundles 45,000 orb minutes and USD 20 of agent usage; the free path links a ChatGPT subscription or any key in inference/ and runs the agent on the user's own runner
